_comment: Hand-reviewed overlay for gen_migration_map.py. Keyed by the agent name at the OLD ref. fate: renamed | merged | deleted. to: the successor agent at the new ref, or null where git history names no catalog successor. also: further successors when the old scope was split. Every entry is sourced from the squash-commit message of the PR named in pr.

codebase-explorer.note: Removed with no catalog successor. bc0e03a: it duplicated Claude Code's built-in Explore agent; the READMEs now point codebase search at the built-in.

search-specialist.note: bc0e03a: search method folded into research-analyst as a 'Search strategy' section. Code search is left to the built-in Explore.

data-researcher.note: bc0e03a: dataset finding and vetting folded into research-analyst as 'Dataset sourcing'. The commit says execution-side analysis belongs to data-analyst and data-scientist (category 15), which already existed.

market-researcher.note: bc0e03a: folded into research-analyst as 'Market sizing and segmentation'.

competitive-analyst.note: bc0e03a: folded into research-analyst as 'Competitive analysis'. Library and framework comparisons route to technology-researcher.

trend-analyst.note: bc0e03a: folded into research-analyst as 'Trend and foresight analysis'.

powershell-5.1-expert.note: a225f96: four PowerShell agents merged into one powershell-expert that detects the edition.

powershell-7-expert.note: a225f96: four PowerShell agents merged into one powershell-expert that detects the edition.

powershell-module-architect.note: a225f96: four PowerShell agents merged into one powershell-expert.

powershell-ui-architect.note: a225f96: four PowerShell agents merged into one powershell-expert.

dotnet-framework-4.8-expert.note: Scope split over two PRs; not a git rename. a225f96 (#369) deleted it and 'replaced' it with dotnet-modernizer (category 10), scoped to migrating .NET Framework to modern .NET only. f106796 (#374) says .NET Framework maintenance, 'orphaned since #369', is back in scope in dotnet-expert. Primary successor chosen as dotnet-expert (maintaining Framework code, the old agent's job) is a reviewer's judgement; migrations go to dotnet-modernizer.

csharp-developer.note: f106796: csharp-developer and dotnet-core-expert merged into one version-agnostic dotnet-expert.

dotnet-core-expert.note: f106796: csharp-developer and dotnet-core-expert merged into one version-agnostic dotnet-expert.
